shared_elements: relief carving raised from a flat stone surface
animal or creature shown in profile with limbs
continuous curved/linear band running across the field
figures rendered in low relief on a vertical face
justification: Both surfaces carry low-relief carving on a stone face and both include a figure in profile against a plain ground, but A shows a procession of clothed human figures in file, each with garments, headgear and held objects, while B shows a single schematic quadruped/reptile-like creature with angular bent limbs above a long sweeping arc, with no human figures at all. The correspondence is limited to the generic fact of profile relief figures; the specific motifs, their combinations and the compositional schemes share nothing distinctive.
